breaking_news.headline: The U.S. Strategic Petroleum Reserve is low. Here's why you should care
breaking_news.summary: The U.S. has tapped into its strategic oil reserve to help drive down rising gasoline prices in the wake of the war with Iran. Can oil from Venezuela help fill it back up?

breaking_news.headline: American farmers are hurting -- and worried about their futures
breaking_news.summary: Farmers who grow soybeans, corn, cotton and other crops are facing another year of losses as soaring fuel and fertilizer costs offset higher revenues.

breaking_news.headline: Why this Pokémon set is dropping in value
breaking_news.summary: How does one price a cemetery plot? Are they using dynamic pricing to figure it out? We tackle that question and many more in this week's Indicator newsletter.

breaking_news.headline: Aga's restaurant in Houston is number one in the world for Uber Eats deliveries
breaking_news.summary: In Houston, Aga's Indian-Pakistani restaurant serves around 4,000 meals a day and according to Uber Eats, it has the most takeout orders in the world on the their platform.

breaking_news.headline: Everyone is racing to create an AI device. Meta thinks it has one
breaking_news.summary: Tech companies are betting that people will connect with AI using something other than smartphones. Meta is going all-in on glasses, after launching its new AI agent Muse.

breaking_news.headline: Oura puts a ring on Wall Street with one of this year's biggest IPOs
breaking_news.summary: The leading smart ring manufacturer is betting its trove of health data will be a hit with Wall Street.

breaking_news.headline: What we know about the suspected U.K. terror plot. And, why the Gulf remains in limbo
breaking_news.summary: What we know — and still don't — about the suspected terror plot near a U.K. air base. Trump rejects Iran's offer to pause fighting. And CNN prepares for new owners with ties to Trump.

breaking_news.headline: The Trump administration weakens fuel efficiency standards for new cars
breaking_news.summary: The Trump administration says easing these standards will make cars more affordable. Critics say it's not so simple and could be costly for the environment.

breaking_news.headline: Four bodies found after avalanche hits Himalayan climbing group
breaking_news.summary: Rescuers are still looking for 12 Nepalese cook staff who were preparing for climbers to ascend the Himlung Himal peak.

breaking_news.headline: Stand-up comic released after being convicted of insulting Erdoğan
breaking_news.summary: Turkish comedian Deniz Göktaş also faces a travel ban but has been released due to time served.

breaking_news.headline: Iran court upholds lashes sentence for singer who performed without hijab
breaking_news.summary: Parastoo Ahmadi was convicted of "offending public decency" after singing while wearing a sleeveless dress during a livestreamed concert.

breaking_news.headline: Nigerian attempts to break world record by dancing non-stop for seven days
breaking_news.summary: Crowds have gathered in Lagos to watch Ben Dancer, who says he will carry on dancing until Tuesday morning.

breaking_news.headline: French PM warns against escalation of school protests after 164 arrested
breaking_news.summary: Students are protesting over issues such as overcrowded classes, but the prime minister has condemned reports of violence.

breaking_news.headline: Twelve women have been killed in one part of South Africa since July. Here's what we know so far
breaking_news.summary: South African President Cyril Ramaphosa says the murders are a "stain on our national conscience".

breaking_news.headline: Seoul summons Ukraine envoy over North Korean prisoner-of-war row
breaking_news.summary: Last week Zelensky revealed Ukraine had sent two captured North Koreans to South Korea - which Seoul says was meant to be a secret.

breaking_news.headline: Inside Yemen's front-line city as Houthis battle for control
breaking_news.summary: In rare access to Yemen's conflict zone the BBC travels to the front line with pro-government soldiers.

breaking_news.headline: Best thing we can offer young people is a job, not benefits, says chancellor
breaking_news.summary: John Healey's speech comes ahead of next month's Budget, as he faces pressure to bring down government borrowing costs.

breaking_news.headline: Why the PM could finally drop the triple lock pension pledge
breaking_news.summary: Andy Burnham said that he would make tough decisions to fund a new national care service.

breaking_news.headline: Why UK diesel prices have hit an all-time high
breaking_news.summary: The average price of a litre of diesel at the pump stands at 198.32p, according to the RAC motoring body.

breaking_news.headline: What is the Budget and what could be in it?
breaking_news.summary: Chancellor John Healey will set out his plans for UK taxes in October.
